name: Headless Demo
description: Counter app demonstrating headless tools, peer.emit, KV proxy, and lazy-open

tools.name: increment
tools.description: Increment the counter by a given amount (default 1). Runs in background — no panel needed.

tools.name: read_counter
tools.description: Read the current counter value. Runs in background — no panel needed.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset the counter to zero. Runs in background — no panel needed.

tools.name: show_counter
tools.description: Show the counter value in the app's panel UI.
